_comment: Maintained registry of information sources for the daily Hot Topics report. Edit this file to add/remove/re-prioritize sources. The Hot Topics skill reads this and checks every enabled source. 'within_days' scopes how recent an item must be to count. Set 'enabled' to false to skip a source without deleting it.
ercot_market_focus: Only count topics relevant to the ERCOT wholesale/retail power market: real-time & day-ahead energy, ancillary services (RRS, ECRS, Non-Spin, Reg), RTC+B (real-time co-optimization + batteries), ORDC/scarcity pricing, reliability standards (PRC, reserve margin), interconnection & GINR, transmission (RIOP, CCN, 765kV), DER/aggregation, large load / data centers, market rules (NPRR/NOGRR/PGRR/etc.), congestion & CRR, weather/grid conditions, capacity/PCM, and PUCT policy affecting ERCOT. Drop anything not tied to the ERCOT footprint.

ercot_official.name: ERCOT Market Notices & Announcements
ercot_official.notes: Official market notices, alerts, and operational messages.

stakeholder_meetings.name: ERCOT stakeholder meetings (recent, on disk)
stakeholder_meetings.notes: gen_hot_topics.py auto-discovers any committee meeting dated within 'within_days'. Summarize the agendas/materials of those meetings. Live fallback: https://www.ercot.com/committees

puct.name: PUCT Open Meeting (agendas & orders)
puct.notes: Most recent PUCT open meeting affecting ERCOT: agenda items, orders, rulemakings. Interchange filings search: https://interchange.puc.texas.gov/

news_sites.name: RTO Insider — ERCOT
news_sites.notes: Gold standard for ISO/RTO market & stakeholder coverage.

news_sites.name: Utility Dive
news_sites.notes: Broad U.S. power-sector news; strong ERCOT/Texas coverage.
